# Airwallex Product Documentation

## Connected Accounts

Programmatically create connected accounts for businesses and individuals, and enable them with rich financial capabilities.

- [Connected Accounts](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/overview.md): Programmatically create connected accounts for businesses and individuals, and enable them with rich financial capabilities.
- [About connected accounts](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/about/about-connected-accounts.md): Understand what connected accounts are, how the platform model works, and how connected accounts underpin Embedded Finance use cases built on Airwallex.
- [Account capabilities](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/about/account-capabilities.md): Understand the financial capabilities available to connected accounts, how they are enabled through onboarding, and what they unlock for your platform and end users.
- [Account types](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/about/account-types.md): Understand the three connected account types—ledger, withdrawal, and full—and the business vs. individual distinction, to make the right choice for your platform.
- [Charges](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/move-funds/charges.md)
- [Charges and CA transfers statuses](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/move-funds/charges-and-ca-transfers-statuses.md)

- [Connected Account (CA) transfers](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/move-funds/connected-account-(ca)-transfers.md)
- [Connected Account Console overview](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/manage-accounts/connected-account-console-overview.md)
- [Connected accounts and Embedded Finance solutions](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/about/connected-accounts-and-embedded-finance.md): Understand how connected accounts underpin Airwallex's Embedded Finance solutions and how account type varies across Global Treasury, Banking as a Service, and Payments for Platforms use cases.
- [Error codes](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/move-funds/error-codes.md)
- [Get started with connected accounts](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/connected-accounts/get-started/get-started-with-connected-accounts.md)

## Payments

Accept payments from shoppers around the world with cards and 160+ alternative payment methods.

- [About Airwallex Payments](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/payments/about-airwallex-payments.md)
- [Airwallex Merchant of Record overview](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/payments/merchant-of-record.md): Sell digital products globally without registering for tax in every market. With Airwallex Merchant of Record, Airwallex acts as the legal seller and manages sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for each sale.
- [Integration options](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/payments/integration-options.md): Learn about your integration options for accepting payments with Airwallex Payments.
- [Overview](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/payments/optimize-your-integration.md): Improve payment success and conversion with localized pricing and payment methods, reduce scheme costs for saved cards, and make recurring payments more reliable.
- [Overview](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/payments/payment-operations.md): Manage authorizations and refunds, handle disputes, prevent fraud, and reconcile payment activity
- [Payments](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/payments/overview.md): Accept payments from shoppers around the world with cards and 160+ alternative payment methods.

## Billing

Airwallex Billing is built to handle the entire quote to cash process, from complex usage-based billing to simple subscriptions and invoices, empowering you to focus on growing your business.

- [Billing overview](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/overview.md): Airwallex Billing is built to handle the entire quote to cash process, from complex usage-based billing to simple subscriptions and invoices, empowering you to focus on growing your business.
- [Choose your billing solution](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/choose-your-billing-solution.md)
- [Configure your billing settings](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/configure-your-billing-settings.md)
- [Get started with billing](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/get-started-with-billing.md)
- [How Airwallex Billing works](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/how-airwallex-billing-works.md): Understand the billing process, and key concepts involved
- [Supported currencies](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/supported-currencies.md)
- [Automated payment recovery](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/subscriptions/dunning.md): Intelligent dunning logic that maximizes subscription revenue recovery and keeps subscriptions active through cycle-based retry scheduling and customer communications.
- [Checkout](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/billing-components/checkout.md)
- [Credit notes](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/invoicing/credit-notes.md): Issue credit notes to reduce or refund amounts on finalized invoices.
- [Customers](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/billing-components/customers.md)
- [Get started with invoicing](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/invoicing/get-started-with-invoicing.md): Generate invoices and digital payment links with over 160+ local payment methods
- [Get started with subscription management](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/subscriptions/get-started-with-subscription-management.md): Manage simple and hybrid multi-frequency subscription pricing models
- [How Automatic Tax Calculation works](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/airwallex-tax/how-automatic-tax-calculation-works.md): Understand the conceptual model behind Automatic Tax Calculation, including the four pillars, tax inclusion behavior, and when automatic versus manual tax applies.
- [Integration checklist](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/test-and-go-live/integration-checklist.md)
- [Invoices via API](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/invoicing/invoices-via-api.md)
- [Payment sources](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/billing-components/payment-sources.md)

- [Subscriptions via API](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/subscriptions/subscriptions-via-api.md)
- [Supported regions](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/airwallex-tax/supported-regions.md): Full list of countries and sub-national jurisdictions supported by Automatic Tax Calculation.
- [Tax categories](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/airwallex-tax/tax-categories.md): Learn how product tax categories work in Automatic Tax Calculation and find the full list of supported categories.
- [Tax overview](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/airwallex-tax/overview.md): Automatically calculate and apply the correct indirect tax on your Airwallex Billing invoices, subscriptions, and checkout flows.
- [Tax registrations and nexus](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/airwallex-tax/tax-registrations-and-nexus.md): Understand what tax registrations and tax nexus mean, and how they relate to Automatic Tax Calculation in Airwallex Billing.
- [Tax reports and exports](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/airwallex-tax/tax-reports-and-exports.md): Learn how to use Billing's tax CSV exports to support your tax filing, reconciliation, and audit workflows.
- [Use Automatic Tax Calculation](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/billing/airwallex-tax/use-automatic-tax-calculation.md): Understand how Automatic Tax Calculation behaves on invoices, subscriptions, and Hosted Billing Checkout, including inline errors and how to resolve them.

## Issuing

Issue and manage multi-currency cards at scale, while reducing international transaction and FX fees.

- [How Airwallex Issuing works](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/how-airwallex-issuing-works.md)
- [Issuing](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/overview.md): Issue and manage multi-currency cards at scale, while reducing international transaction and FX fees.
- [Supported card programs](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/supported-card-programs.md)

- [3D Secure authentication](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/card-controls/3d-secure-authentication.md): An authentication protocol that adds an extra layer of security for online card payments by verifying cardholders with Airwallex.
- [Address verification](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/transactions/address-verification.md): A cardholder authentication method that validates address information during card transactions to reduce fraud and chargebacks.

- [Authorization expiration](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/transactions/authorization-expiration.md): The time frame after which an approved authorization is automatically released if not cleared or reversed by the merchant.

- [Retrieve physical card delivery details](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/manage-cards/retrieve-physical-card-delivery-details.md)
- [Retrieve sensitive card details](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/manage-cards/retrieve-sensitive-card-details.md)
- [Set up the Platform Liquidity Program](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/get-started/set-up-platform-liquidity-program.md): Configure PLP to fund customer card transactions from a central pool
- [Simulate transactions on issued cards](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/transactions/simulate-transactions-on-issued-cards.md)
- [Transaction failure reasons](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/transactions/transaction-failure-reasons.md)
- [Transaction lifecycle](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/transactions/transaction-lifecycle.md): The three-level Issuing model - lifecycles, card transactions, and transaction events - plus billing amounts, status, fund direction, and how card transaction state changes.
- [Transaction lifecycle (older API versions)](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/legacy-issuing-apis/transaction-lifecycle-(older-api-versions).md): The progression of card transactions through authorization, clearing, and settlement stages for older Issuing API versions.
- [Retrieve lifecycle and transaction data](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/transactions/transaction-lifecycle/retrieve-lifecycle-and-transaction-data.md): Use the Issuing lifecycles, card transactions, and transaction events APIs to retrieve and filter transaction data, and subscribe to webhooks for real-time updates.
- [Transaction events and categories](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/transactions/transaction-lifecycle/transaction-events-and-categories.md): Transaction event types, subtypes, fund movement mapping, and transaction category values for Issuing lifecycles and card transactions.
- [Transaction scenarios](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/issuing/transactions/transaction-lifecycle/transaction-scenarios.md): Example flows by transaction category - purchase, account funding, original credit, cash withdrawal, and bill payment - with authorization, clearing, reversal clearing, declines, and refunds.

## Spend

Control, automate, and reconcile global company spend across expenses and accounts payable.

- [How Airwallex Spend works](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/how-airwallex-spend-works.md): Understand the key features and data model of the Airwallex Spend APIs.
- [Spend](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/overview.md): Control, automate, and reconcile global company spend across expenses and accounts payable.
- [Bills via API](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/accounts-payable/bills-via-api.md): Create, list, retrieve, update, and mark bills as paid programmatically using the Spend API.
- [Card expenses via API](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/expenses/card-expenses-via-api.md): List, retrieve, and update card expenses programmatically using the Spend API.
- [Error codes](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/troubleshooting/error-codes.md): Error codes and troubleshooting guidance for the Spend API.
- [Get your card expenses](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/get-started/get-your-card-expenses.md): Retrieve approved card expenses and mark them as synced to your ERP.
- [Import vendors and POs from your ERP](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/use-cases/import-vendors-and-pos-from-your-erp.md): Synchronize vendor records and purchase orders from your ERP into Airwallex.
- [Purchase orders via API](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/accounts-payable/purchase-orders-via-api.md): Create, list, retrieve, and update purchase orders programmatically using the Spend API.
- [Reimbursements via API](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/expenses/reimbursements-via-api.md): List, retrieve, and manage reimbursement reports programmatically using the Spend API.
- [Set up custom accounting data](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/get-started/set-up-custom-accounting-data.md): Import your chart of accounts, tax rates, and custom fields into Airwallex for use with the Spend APIs.
- [Set up Spend webhooks](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/get-started/set-up-spend-webhooks.md): Configure webhooks to receive real-time notifications for Spend events.
- [Sync card expenses to your ERP](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/use-cases/sync-card-expenses-to-your-erp.md): Automate the synchronization of card expenses from Airwallex to your ERP system.
- [Sync reimbursements and mark as paid externally](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/use-cases/sync-reimbursements-and-mark-as-paid-externally.md): Sync employee reimbursement reports and track external payments through the Spend API.
- [Vendors via API](https://www.airwallex.com/docs/spend/accounts-payable/vendors-via-api.md): Create, list, retrieve, and update vendors programmatically using the Spend API.
